matching_policy.duplicate_policy: Only the strongest candidate in a materially identical root-cause, impact, and remediation cluster can score.
matching_policy.novel_policy: A reproduced, in-scope unmatched cluster is novel-valid for precision but not planted recall or rubric points.
matching_policy.F-01_chain_rule: No F-01 credit unless the report demonstrates the complete flash-funded multiplication of F-02 and F-03 and reaches repayment, retained-profit, and reserve-loss oracles. Separately reported primitives cannot be combined by the scorer.

disagreement_resolutions.scorer_a: C-011 is a partial F-03 match.
disagreement_resolutions.scorer_b: C-011 is novel-valid and F-03 is missed.
disagreement_resolutions.resolution: C-011 is a partial F-03 match and is not also counted as novel-valid.
disagreement_resolutions.basis: F-03's committed partial band explicitly awards 2 points for donation/inflation awareness without connection to posted collateral. C-011 reproducibly shows that a direct donation enters AsterVault's raw-balance totalAssets calculation and inflates the exchange rate. It omits the posted-share, LendingMarket, borrow-limit, and value-extraction path, which is exactly the kind of omitted cross-contract component and impact covered by the partial definition. Its tiny-supply deposit-denial consequence is a distinct observed impact but cannot create an additional precision unit without inflating one raw claim.

disagreement_resolutions.scorer_a: Uses two partial matches and awards the F-03 partial-band points.
disagreement_resolutions.scorer_b: Uses one partial, one novel-valid, and no F-03 points.
disagreement_resolutions.resolution: All derived components use nine exact, two partial, four miss, zero novel-valid, and the F-03 two-point award.
disagreement_resolutions.basis: This follows mechanically from the resolved C-011 assignment.

disagreement_resolutions.issue: Official weighted precision and weighted F1
disagreement_resolutions.scorer_a: Publishes a numeric operationalization using unique precision while also disclosing strict null values.
disagreement_resolutions.scorer_b: Publishes official null values and a separate sensitivity.
disagreement_resolutions.resolution: Official weighted precision and weighted F1 are null; two explicitly non-preregistered sensitivities are reported separately.
disagreement_resolutions.basis: The preregistration names weighted_precision only as an operand and gives no formula. Selecting an operand after reveal would be a protocol invention.

disagreement_resolutions.scorer_a: Primary canonical-severity weighting over matched valid findings.
disagreement_resolutions.scorer_b: Candidate-severity weighting over valid candidates, including unmatched novel-valid C-011.
disagreement_resolutions.resolution: Use canonical-severity weights over matched findings as the primary disclosed operationalization; publish candidate-severity weighting as sensitivity.
disagreement_resolutions.basis: Calibration compares reported severity against a canonical target, so canonical weights provide the stable reference. There is no canonical rank comparator for an unmatched novel claim; after the C-011 resolution all 11 valid candidates are matched.

truth_units.title: Compound AMM and vault-rate amplification makes a flash-funded reserve drain profitable

chain_handling.decision: No inferred credit. C-008 proves F-02 and C-011 earns only partial F-03 primitive credit on a different consumer path. No candidate demonstrates their atomic multiplication, flash repayment, 49,950 retained profit, or 150,000 reserve loss.

truth_units.rationale: The complete composed-only execution and final impact oracle are absent.

truth_units.title: Fallback price uses an instantaneous constant-product reserve ratio

chain_handling.decision: Credited independently as F-02 only; it does not imply F-01.

truth_units.rationale: C-008 reproduces the nonpositive-feed fallback, same-block reserve-ratio manipulation, immediate lending consumption, and profitable undercollateralized borrowing. Its approximately 3.994 price differs from the canonical fixture's greater-than-100 trace but reaches the rubric's root-cause and lending-impact requirements.

truth_units.title: Unsolicited vault balances inflate collateral exchange rates

chain_handling.decision: Partial primitive credit only; it cannot be combined with C-008 to infer F-01.

truth_units.rationale: C-011 proves direct-donation inflation of AsterVault's raw-balance exchange rate. It uses the inflated rate to make a tiny-supply deposit round to zero, not to raise the value of already-posted collateral in LendingMarket. The canonical partial band expressly covers this donation/inflation awareness without the posted-collateral edge.

truth_units.title: Borrow callback reenters collateral withdrawal before debt is committed

chain_handling.decision: One partial unit for the same state-ordering defect; the sibling nested-borrow path is not a second unit.

truth_units.rationale: C-001 proves the callback-before-debt defect and stale-debt reentry, producing debt twice the limit. It recursively borrows rather than reentering withdrawCollateral and never reaches nonzero debt with zero local collateral and recovered shares.

truth_units.title: Collateral-factor authorization condition permits public increases
truth_units.rationale: C-006 reproduces the exact non-guardian truth-table bypass, raises the factor from 7,500 to 9,500 bps, and borrows above the former limit. Consensus severity is Medium, so the explicit five-point cap binds.

truth_units.title: withdraw rounds share burns down and can burn zero shares
truth_units.rationale: No candidate identifies floor-rounded withdrawal burns or demonstrates a zero-share account receiving assets without supply reduction.

truth_units.title: Vault deposit mints from requested rather than received assets

chain_handling.decision: No candidate assignment; F-07 remains distinct from F-14.

truth_units.rationale: No candidate identifies nominal-versus-received deposit accounting, transfer-fee overminting, incumbent dilution, or a profitable cycle.

truth_units.title: Transfer authorization has no chain or verifying-contract domain

chain_handling.decision: Independent exact unit with distinct domain-separation remediation.

truth_units.rationale: C-010 proves the omitted router/chain domain, per-router nonce interaction, two approvals, and replay of identical bytes across two instances. Consensus severity is Medium, so the explicit five-point cap binds.

truth_units.title: Transfer authorization does not bind its recipient

chain_handling.decision: Independent exact unit with distinct recipient-binding remediation.

truth_units.rationale: C-003 identifies recipient's omission from the signed payload, substitutes the relayer as recipient, transfers the full signed amount, and consumes the nonce.

truth_units.title: Bridge finalization ignores the authenticated remote sender

chain_handling.decision: Independent asset-loss unit; nonce namespacing is separately scored.

truth_units.rationale: C-002 proves the missing remote-sender binding, creates 1,000 fabricated bridge collateral from a mismatching sender, and borrows 750 stable against it.

truth_units.title: Bridge replay state collides across configured source chains
truth_units.class: cross-chain replay namespace / denial of service

chain_handling.decision: Independent liveness unit; remote-sender authentication is separately scored.

truth_units.rationale: C-007 configures two source chains, submits legitimate equal-nonce messages, and shows the second valid credit is denied. The canonical exact rubric requires this local liveness impact; permanent source-side stranding is not required.

truth_units.title: Strategy initialization can be repeated to seize the operator role
truth_units.rationale: C-005 reproduces post-setup reinitialization, overwrites both roles, drains the complete module balance, and demonstrates seized execute authority. Frozen consensus severity is High, aligned to canonical.

truth_units.title: Primary oracle path accepts expired price rounds
truth_units.rationale: C-009 proves discarded round freshness data and uses a year-old two-dollar answer to borrow 1,500 against a contemporaneous one-dollar comparator permitting 750.

truth_units.title: Repayment extinguishes nominal debt despite transfer-fee shortfall

chain_handling.decision: No candidate assignment; vault issuance and debt retirement are distinct invariants.

truth_units.rationale: No candidate identifies nominal debt reduction despite a smaller received balance delta or demonstrates settled debt with a reserve deficit.

truth_units.title: Signature-byte replay key is bypassed with ECDSA malleability
truth_units.rationale: C-004 proves equivalent low-s/high-s signatures, distinct raw replay keys, and repeated payment for one payload. The available candidate log shows the committed two-payment oracle; the embedded blind-consensus boundary reports four accepted encodings, which does not alter exact credit.

candidate_dispositions.title: Any user can raise the global collateral factor

candidate_dispositions.title: Bridge replay nonce is global across source chains

candidate_dispositions.title: Manipulable reserve spot price is trusted during feed fallback

candidate_dispositions.title: Positive primary price is accepted indefinitely

candidate_dispositions.rationale: Exact router-domain replay; candidate severity is one rank below canonical.

candidate_dispositions.title: First-share donation can deny vault deposits
candidate_dispositions.unscored_distinct_impact: The reproduced tiny-supply deposit denial is useful additional evidence but is not counted as a second novel unit.
candidate_dispositions.rationale: Direct-donation exchange-rate inflation is the F-03 primitive, but the committed posted-collateral and lending impact are absent.
